_note: Per-role qualification thresholds for the s16-reviewer-recovery-v1 split-lane campaign. NEVER edits native-review-thresholds.v2.json (frozen Layer-N instrument). E-07 fix: every SOFT threshold (any bar strictly between 0 and 1) carries a paired minimumDenominator, and a soft capability whose per-capability denominator is below minSoftDenominator is refused as UNDERPOWERED (a distinct qualifyRole outcome), never silently passed on tiny n. This eliminates the 0.85-over-4 brittleness where 3/4=0.75 flipped a judge. Hard 1.0 bars and max-*=0 caps are exact and do not take a minimum denominator. Thresholds are frozen before any live output (gold-governance rule I); a material change terminates the experiment id and starts a new one.

governance.sourceOfSoftDenominators: the built role corpora (reader/source/quiz-corpus.v1.json); H1/H2/H3 compositions guarantee each soft denominator >= 10

_rationale.minHardBlockerSensitivity: 1.00 over the 8 planted reader-visible hard blockers — a qualified reader must catch every one; a 1.0 bar is not subject to the soft minimum-denominator rule.
_rationale.minCleanPassRate: 0.75 over 12 clean controls (den >= 10) — a qualified reader ships genuinely clean chapters while tolerating some conservative non-ships.
_rationale.minNonBlockerCalibrationRate: 0.85 over 10 craft weaknesses (den >= 10) — must not escalate mild craft into a blocker.
_rationale.minQuoteEvidenceValidityRate: 0.95 — cited evidenceSpans must byte-verify against the chapter.

_rationale.minCausalOverreachDetectionRate: 1.00 — causal overreach beyond the licensed claim strength is zero-miss.
_rationale.minSourceContradictionDetectionRate: 1.00 — a claim contradicting the source is zero-miss.
_rationale.minMissingEvidenceInconclusiveHonestyRat: 1.00 — missing evidence must be INCONCLUSIVE, never guessed, never converted to PASS.
_rationale.minCleanFamilyPassRate: 0.85 over the pooled PASS-gold source families (supported-source-bound + framed-constructed + clean-generic + qualified-correlation; den >= 10) — a qualified source reviewer must PASS genuinely clean licensed units.
_rationale.minRegisterClassificationAccuracy: 0.85 over ALL source cases (den >= 10) — visibleRegister classification accuracy across clearly_sourced/constructed/generic/ambiguous/presented_as_fact.

_rationale.minKeyMismatchDetectionRate: 1.00 over 10 key-mismatch cases — wrong-key is deterministically decidable (keyCorrect==='wrong'); a miss is disqualifying and not subject to the soft-denominator rule.
_rationale.minGenuineAmbiguityDetectionRate: 0.85 over 10 genuinely-ambiguous cases (den >= 10, replacing the retired 0.85-over-4). Every ambiguity gold survives an adversarial single-best-answer attempt.
_rationale.minMechanismMatchDetectionRate: 0.85 over 10 mechanism/causal-key cases — mechanismSupported===false on a mechanism/causal item is a block.

security.inheritanceRule: LN-08 delegates the security-boundary capability to Stage-Q Layer-O. A profile present in the frozen Layer-O v3 panel with ALL_THREE_JUDGES_QUALIFIED inherits QUALIFIED; a profile absent from that panel is NOT_TESTED. No security cases are added to any split-lane corpus.
